newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Braidwood, Ill., nuke at full power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Braidwood, Ill., nuke at full power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,120 megawatt (MW) Braidwood nuclear unit 1 was producing at 100 percent of capacity Wednesday after a weekend outage for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"We're certainly at full load now," spokesman Gary Wald said Wednesday.
The Braidwood, Ill., unit was taken off line early Saturday for valve repairs and resumed power output Tuesday.
The 1,120 MW Braidwood unit 2 was also operating at 100 percent output, Wald said.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
